name: tpl-chain-response-3-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. If the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires that the agent reaches the exit while holding the box. The current clauses only guarantee that the agent at some point reaches the exit (Existence(at_exit)) and that the agent at some point holds the box (Existence(holding_box)), but they do not enforce that these two conditions coincide. Add a clause that ties the two together, e.g. a hard Response(at_exit, holding_box) or a hard Existence(at_exit & holding_box), to ensure the agent carries the box to the exit. With this additional clause, the clauses fully capture the task.

texts: The agent must eventually reach the exit
The agent must eventually be holding the box while at the exit
If the box falls, the agent must pick it up again on the very next move
